title: Golf, Grill & Chill Heated Pool, Sleeps 16
description:
Welcome to Golf, Grill & Chill – the ultimate Scottsdale getaway for golf trips, family vacations, and group retreats.

Inside, you'll find comfortable accommodations for up to 16 guests with a fully equipped kitchen. Whether you're planning a golf weekend, spring training trip, family reunion, bachelor getaway, or friends' escape, Golf, Grill & Chill is the perfect home base.
amenities: Private hot tub - available all year, open 24 hours
review_snippets: This home is a guest favorite based on ratings, reviews, and reliability
Great location close to activities and dining! Scott was very responsive and helpful. Loved having extras at the house for things we forgot.
HUGE house for the area. Very convenient location, short drives anywhere. Clean and great amenities.

This airbnb was perfect for our group! Everyone had a room and there was a plethora of beds. The pool and hot tub were in great condition as well as the outdoor kitchen. It had literally everything we could have needed. Upon check-in, the host called me to walk me through the house and show me anything that I could have had questions about. Great hosts and great house! We will definitely be back here.
Great house in a convenient location!

Exceeded expectations! Perfect for our group of 16 girls - plenty of bathroom space, closets, towels. Large gathering areas for group meals and hangs. Backyard had great photo ops and was perfect for entertaining.
